issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: dif.sh
products.tagline: Markdown feature flags your coding agent installs for you
products.summaryZh: Markdown 功能开关，由你的编码代理为你自动安装
products.descriptionZh: 开源功能开关。每个开关都是一个markdown文件，与其控制的代码共存：它做什么、为什么存在、你做了什么决定，像任何其他变更一样在PR中审查。你的编码代理通过一条命令安装Dif，无需账户，并读取上下文文件，从而了解哪些功能已上线、哪些尝试过。A/B测试停留在同一文件中，直到你有流量。将事件发送到你自己的分析系统，或让Dif Cloud读取结果并将决策写入文件。
products.description: Open source feature flags. Every flag is a markdown file that lives with the code it controls: what it does, why it exists, and what you decided, reviewed in a PR like any other change. Your coding agent installs Dif in one command, no account, and reads the context file so it knows what's live and what was already tried. A/B tests wait in the same files until you have traffic. Send events to your own analytics, or let Dif Cloud read the results and write the decision into the file.

products.name: Reflexio
products.tagline: Behavioral learning that makes AI agents better over time
products.summaryZh: 随时间推移，行为学习使AI代理不断优化。
products.descriptionZh: Reflexio让AI代理在每次交互中不断进步。当用户纠正代理、路径失败或某次表现特别出色时，Reflexio会将这一经验转化为代理下次可复用的行为。不再让宝贵教训埋没在日志中，你的代理会持续学习该重复什么、该避免什么——且每次学习都可见、可测试、可回退。任务失败率降低超过30%，同时节省超过60%的令牌。
products.description: Reflexio makes AI agents better with every interaction. When users correct an agent, a path fails, or something works particularly well, Reflexio turns that experience into behavior the agent can reuse next time. Instead of leaving valuable lessons buried in logs, your agent continuously learns what to repeat and what to avoid — with every learning visible, testable, and reversible. Reduce task failure rate by more than 30%, while saving tokens by more than 60%.

products.name: Ponytail
products.tagline: Make new code the last resort
products.summaryZh: 让新代码成为最后的选择。
products.descriptionZh: Ponytail是一款插件，旨在让编码代理编写最少可行代码。在添加任何内容之前，它会检查变更是否必要、是否已存在，或能否使用标准库或原生API。相同行为，更少代码行数。
products.description: Ponytail is a plugin that makes coding agents write the least code that works. Before adding anything, it checks whether the change is needed, already exists, or can use the stdlib or a native API. Same behavior, fewer lines to own.

products.name: Hyperprobe
products.tagline: Lets your AI agents debug production without redeploying
products.summaryZh: 让您的AI代理无需重新部署即可调试生产环境
products.descriptionZh: HyperProbe帮助后端团队调试无法在本地复现的生产环境问题。无需添加日志行并等待部署，我们让Claude Code、Codex或Cursor在运行中的服务中植入只读探针，捕获从未被记录的变量状态。由此，你的代理如同拥有本地复现环境般进行调试，一次性解决bug。
products.description: HyperProbe is how backend teams debug production issues they can't reproduce locally. Instead of adding a log line and waiting on a deploy, we let Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor drop read-only probes into a running service and capture the variable state that was never recorded. From there your agent debugs like it has a local repro, closing the bug in one sitting.

products.name: at8pm
products.tagline: Your honest journal
products.summaryZh: 你的诚实日记
products.descriptionZh: 你今天写的每一条记录都会在你设定的时间锁定——默认是晚上8点。一旦锁定，就无法更改：不能编辑，不能重写历史，也不能悄悄修饰你当时真实的感受。留下的只是对一天诚实、原始且不加过滤的记录。条目通过你自己的私有iCloud在设备间同步，绝不经过任何第一方或第三方服务器。当打字不足以表达时，可以录制一段squope（方形视频）或音频笔记。at8pm可免费下载（每天最多2条记录）。
products.description: Every entry you write today locks at the time that you configured — 8pm by default. Once it locks, that's it: no editing, no rewriting history, no quietly polishing what you actually felt in the moment. Just an honest, raw, and unfiltered record of your day. Entries sync across your devices with your own private iCloud and never with a first/third-party server. When typing is not enough, record a squope (square video) or an audio note. at8pm is free to download (up to 2 entries per day).

products.name: Experiential Labs
products.tagline: Open source AI gateway turning traffic into a better model
products.summaryZh: 开源AI网关，将流量转化为更优模型
products.descriptionZh: Experiential是开源的、零加价网关，支持BYOK、自托管及1000多个市场模型。它通过分析您的流量来降低成本、推荐更优模型，并训练您专属的定制模型。
products.description: Experiential is the open source, zero markup gateway for BYOK, self-hosted and 1000+ marketplace models. It learns from your traffic to cut costs, recommend better models, and train a specialized model you own.

products.name: PostBox
products.tagline: Stage and post designs from your mac
products.summaryZh: 在Mac上编排和发布设计作品
products.descriptionZh: PostBox将MacBook的刘海变成你作品的拖放海报。拖入一个导出文件，写一次说明，即可同时发布到X、Bluesky、Threads、LinkedIn、Dribbble、Instagram、Threads、Pinterest、Behance和Cosmos。
products.description: PostBox turns the MacBook notch into a drag and drop poster for the work you make. Drag an export in, write the caption once, and post to X, Bluesky, Threads, LinkedIn, Dribbble, Instagram, Threads, Pinterest Behance and Cosmos at once.

products.name: CommuteBar
products.tagline: Live commute times in your menu bar
products.summaryZh: 菜单栏中的实时通勤时间
products.descriptionZh: 瞄一眼路况，准时出发。CommuteBar 将实时通勤时间直观显示在 Mac 菜单栏上，无需切换应用。可保存多个目的地，如办公室、学校、健身房。为固定通勤安排自动切换，并获取“即将出发”/“立即出发”提示及可选通知。还提供路线对比、交通延误提醒及多种出行方式。
products.description: Glance at traffic. Leave on time. CommuteBar puts live commute times visibly on your Mac menu bar, no app-switching required. Save multiple destinations like office, school, gym. Schedule automatic switching for recurring commutes and get leave soon / leave now indicators and optional notifications. You also get route comparison, delayed traffic alerts and different travel modes.

products.name: Queuebrick
products.tagline: The Letterboxd alternative
products.summaryZh: Letterboxd 的替代选择
products.descriptionZh: 快速、优雅的电影追踪。搜索影片、评分、加入队列、排列接下来要看的内容。Letterboxd 的替代选择。
products.description: Fast, elegant movie tracking. Search a film, rate it, queue it, rank what to watch next. The Letterboxd alternative.

products.name: Retold
products.tagline: Turn family voices into hand-drawn story films
products.summaryZh: 将家庭的声音转化为手绘故事影片
products.descriptionZh: 录制一段记忆或导入旧的语音备忘。Retold保留真实声音，将故事转化为手绘影片和可阅读的书籍。素描跟随讲述中的人物、地点和细节，每段记忆都保存在你的家庭书架上。
products.description: Record a memory or import an old voice note. Retold keeps the real voice and turns the story into a hand-drawn film and readable book. The sketches follow the people, places and little details as they are spoken, then every memory is kept together on your family shelf.

products.name: GitWarren
products.tagline: Review code with your coding agents before committing
products.summaryZh: 在提交前，与你的编码代理一起审查代码。
products.descriptionZh: 这是一款本地化的、类似PR的代码审查应用，直接与你的工作树协同工作。你可以审查已提交、已暂存、未暂存及未跟踪的更改，留下内联评论，并将工作组织成实际的审查，无需推送任何内容到任何地方。通过MCP连接你正在使用的任何AI，获得连贯的体验，免去繁琐的复制粘贴。所有评论都附着在特定代码更改的线程中，便于随时间追踪进展。
products.description: It’s a local, PR-like code review app that works directly with your working tree. You can review committed, staged, unstaged, and untracked changes, leave inline comments, and organize the work into actual reviews without having to push anything anywhere. You connect whatever AI you're using through MCP and have a coherent experience without all the mundane copy-pasting. All comments live in threads attached to specific code changes, so it’s easy to follow what’s going on over time.

products.name: BrickForgerAI
products.tagline: Turn any prompt into a brick set you can actually build
products.summaryZh: 将任何提示词转化为一套可以实际搭建的积木套装。
products.descriptionZh: 输入提示，即可获得可搭建的砖块模型。AI（图像与网格生成）只是入口，真正的工作在于砖块放置引擎：将形状体素化，用实际兼容乐高的零件进行铺设，交错接缝以增强强度，运行结构分析（重力载荷）以发现薄弱点，再用斜面与平板进行细化（目前包含55种砖块零件库）。你将获得一个ldr文件、零件清单和分步PDF说明书。下方渲染图使用Mecabricks Advanced插件完成。
products.description: Type a prompt, get a buildable brick model. The AI (image + mesh gen) is just the front door. The real work is the brick-placing engine: voxelizing the shape, tiling it with actual LEGO-compatible parts, staggering seams for strength, running structural analysis (gravity load) to catch weak points, then refining with slopes and tiles (currently a 55 part brick library). You get a realldr file, parts list, and step-by-step PDF instructions. Renders below done with the Mecabricks Advanced add-on.

products.name: ​​AI Agents Listing​
products.tagline: ​​The agentic AI ecosystem, in one directory​
products.summaryZh: 智能体AI生态系统，一目录尽览
products.descriptionZh: 代理式AI技术栈目录：执行实际工作的AI代理、将其连接至您的工具与数据的MCP服务器，以及扩展其能力的代理技能。每个条目均拥有可索引页面，页面间跨三层相互链接，因此代理会展示其协作的MCP服务器及扩展其功能的技能。搜索、分类、对比及替代方案贯穿全部内容。收录免费。
products.description: A directory of the agentic AI stack: AI agents that do real work, MCP servers that connect them to your tools and data, and agent skills that extend what they can do. Every listing gets an indexable page, and pages link across the three layers, so an agent shows the MCP servers it works with and the skills that extend it. Search, categories, comparisons and alternatives run across all of it. Listing is free.

products.name: LiftmyCV 3.0
products.tagline: Your personal AI job search & auto-apply agent.
products.summaryZh: 你的个人AI求职与自动申请助手。
products.descriptionZh: 欢迎了解全新的LiftmyCV 3.0，这是一款一站式AI求职平台，能为您匹配相关职位、生成针对特定职位的简历和求职信，并代您提交申请。此版本引入了全新用户界面、包含超过160万个职位的Job Hub，以及5种自动申请模式，包括First和Stealth Apply，它们会自动扫描过去24小时内发布的职位，与您的个人资料匹配，并自主申请——无需Chrome扩展。
products.description: Meet the brand-new LiftmyCV 3.0, an all-in-one AI job search platform that matches you with relevant jobs, generates job-specific resumes and cover letters, and applies on your behalf. This version introduces a new user interface, a Job Hub with 1.6M+ job openings, and 5 auto-apply modes, including First and Stealth Apply, which automatically scan jobs posted within the past 24 hours, match them to your profile, and apply autonomously – no Chrome extension required.

products.name: Brain Rest
products.tagline: Don’t let your browser rot your brain
products.summaryZh: 别让浏览器侵蚀你的大脑
products.descriptionZh: Brain Rest将浏览器屏幕时间转化为一个你真正愿意守护的角色。在一个面板中查看所有网站和标签页，观察你的大脑状态从清醒滑向枯竭，并通过页面内小组件保持觉察而不打断工作流。当觉察不够时，可设置每日网站限额、屏蔽干扰网站、启动专注模式或番茄钟，并跟随引导休息。适用于Chrome和Edge，提供免费方案及可选Pro功能。
products.description: Brain Rest turns browser screen time into a character you’ll actually want to protect. See every site and tab in one dashboard, watch your Brain Level shift from Fresh to Dead, and use an on-page widget to stay aware without breaking your flow. When awareness isn’t enough, set daily website limits, block distracting sites, start Focus Mode or Pomodoro, and take guided breaks. Available for Chrome and Edge with a free plan and optional Pro features.

products.name: Muse Spark 1.3
products.tagline: Meta’s flagship for coding and long-horizon agents
products.summaryZh: Meta旗舰级编码与长程智能体产品
products.descriptionZh: Muse Spark 1.3是Meta面向智能体工作与编程的最新旗舰模型。API价格与1.2版相同，为1.25美元/4.25美元，在Meta自身的对比中，工具调用次数减少约20%，编程相关token消耗减少25%。它在DeepSWE v1.1上以75.4分领先，在Terminal-Bench 2.1上以88.8分持平。今日起在Muse Code和Meta Model API中上线。最大推理能力将在安全测试后推出。
products.description: Muse Spark 1.3 is Meta’s latest flagship for agentic work and coding. Same $1.25 / $4.25 API price as 1.2, with about 20% fewer tool calls and 25% fewer tokens on coding in Meta’s own comparisons. It leads DeepSWE v1.1 at 75.4 and ties Terminal-Bench 2.1 at 88.8. Live today in Muse Code and the Meta Model API. Max reasoning follows after safety testing.

products.name: Autnest: Drive & AI
products.tagline: Automotive hub for drivers & garages — with AI built in
products.summaryZh: 面向驾驶员与维修厂的车载中枢——内置AI
products.descriptionZh: Autnest将汽车生活汇聚一处——数字车库、实时地图、交易市场、社区和道路救援。Drive.AI提供研究、诊断式指导和损坏处理流程，作为决策支持——并非专业检查的替代品。面向车库和企业：提供列表、库存和客户运营的工作区工具。为真实道路而生。支持Web、iOS和Android平台。免费起步。
products.description: Autnest brings car life into one place — digital garage, live map, marketplace, community, and roadside help. Drive.AI helps with research, diagnostic-style guidance, and damage workflows as decision support — not a substitute for professional inspection. For garages and businesses: workspace tools for listings, inventory, and customer ops. Built for real roads. Web + iOS + Android. Free to start.

products.name: supatools
products.tagline: The directory for product makers
products.summaryZh: 面向产品制造者的目录
products.descriptionZh: 发现最佳网页开发工具、库和资源，助您构建下一个项目。
products.description: Discover the best web development tools, libraries, and resources to help you build your next project.

products.name: Traction
products.tagline: helps indie founders get marketing traction
products.summaryZh: 帮助独立开发者获得市场关注。
products.descriptionZh: 企业获取客户有19种途径。OnlyTraction运用AI执行靶心框架，将其缩小至两三个胜算最高的机会，再确定测试策略。涵盖会议、社区、1500多个目录，并配备Chrome扩展程序自动填写表单，加速曝光。连接Stripe后，每项实验旁都会显示MRR数值。
products.description: There are 19 ways a company gets customers. OnlyTraction runs the Bullseye Framework using AI to narrow them to two or three winning opportunities. Then the tactics to test. The conferences, the communities, 1,500+ directories, with a Chrome extension that fills the forms to get exposure quicker. Connect Stripe and every experiment gets an MRR number beside it.

products.name: Malyatko — Baby tracker
products.tagline: Privacy-first baby tracker that works fully offline
products.summaryZh: 隐私优先的婴儿追踪器，完全离线运行
products.descriptionZh: Malyatko是一款注重隐私的婴幼儿追踪应用，专为宝宝出生后的头几年设计。与大多数追踪应用不同，它无需注册账户，不显示广告，且完全离线运行——宝宝的资料仅保存在您的设备和iCloud中，而非服务器上。可追踪18种活动类型（睡眠、喂养、尿布、体重、体温、用药），并提供图表、成长里程碑、将记录转化为简单建议的AI洞察，以及睡眠预测功能。支持Apple Watch、小组件和iCloud家庭共享。免费使用，可选高级版。
products.description: Malyatko is a privacy-first baby tracker for the first years. Unlike most trackers it needs no account, shows no ads, and works fully offline — your baby's data stays on your device and iCloud, not a server. Track 18 activity types (sleep, feeding, diapers, weight, temperature, meds) with charts, development milestones, AI insights that turn your logs into simple tips, and sleep predictions. Apple Watch, widgets, and iCloud family sharing. Free, with optional premium.
